title: OSB incremental knowledge event
description: One line of .osb/knowledge/events/<task-id>.jsonl (osb/references/knowledge.md). Extended in Phase 5 (P1-E) with provenance/freshness fields so retrieval can tell current source-derived evidence from superseded history.

id.description: Stable id for this entry, e.g. a short hash of repository_id+file+summary — used to reference it from a later 'superseded_by'.

repository_id.description: Required in a multi-repo workspace (osb/docs/MULTI_REPO.md) so retrieval never merges results across repositories ambiguously. Null/absent in single-repo mode.

source_path.description: The specific file/symbol this entry is derived from, when applicable.

source_revision.description: Commit SHA or content fingerprint of source_path at the time this entry was recorded. Used to detect when the source has since changed (osb/references/knowledge.md §Provenance and freshness).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp this entry was recorded.

lifecycle_status.description: 'provisional': not yet independently confirmed. 'verified': confirmed by Reviewer/QA or a re-check against current source. 'superseded': kept for audit history, no longer authoritative — see superseded_by.

superseded_by.description: id of the entry that superseded this one, required when lifecycle_status is 'superseded'.
